description: In every PA-model, a predicate defined by an arithmetic formula with parameters satisfies strong induction in the arithmetic order.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.definable_strong_induction.{u} {M : Type u}
  [Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.language.Structure M]
  [M ⊨ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.PA] (P : M → Prop)
  (hP : Set.univ.Definable₁ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.language {x | P x})
  (hs :
    ∀ (x : M),
      (∀ (y : M),
          Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticRepresentability.leValue M
              (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.succValue M y) x →
            P y) →
        P x)
  (x : M) : P x
